title: Not One Belief: Answer Payloads, Persistence, and Dissociated Confidence Signals in Conversational Question Answering
abstract: arXiv:2610.35694v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Conversational QA systems should fix errors when users push back and signal which answers to trust. We split each follow-up into its speech act (re-ask, agree, or challenge) and its payload (an answer string, correct or not), and measure four confidence signals on the same transcripts: verbalized confidence, length-normalized likelihood, a frozen hidden-state probe, and P(True). Answers change when the user supplies an answer string and almost never under the speech act alone: in every retained full-size cell, the correct answer converts at least four times as many wrong answers as re-asking or agreement. The four signals disagree. On Qwen2.5-7B the frozen probe rises with answer persistence rather than truth; this holds on held-out questions, with Llama-3-8B (cleaned answers) as support, but not on four other models. translated_title: 并非单一信念：对话式问答中的答案载荷、持久性与分离的置信度信号
translated_abstract: 对话式问答系统应当在用户提出异议时纠正错误，并指示哪些答案值得信任。我们将每条后续提问分解为其言语行为（重新提问、认同或质疑）及其载荷（一个答案字符串，无论正确与否），并在相同的对话记录上测量四种置信度信号：口头表达的置信度、长度归一化似然、冻结的隐状态探测器以及P(True)。当用户提供答案字符串时答案会发生改变，而在仅有言语行为的情况下几乎从不改变：在所有保留的全尺寸实验单元中，正确的答案载荷对错误答案的纠正效果至少是重新提问或认同的四倍。这四种置信度信号彼此不一致。在Qwen2.5-7B上，冻结的探测器随答案的持久性而非真实性而升高；这一发现在留出问题上依然成立，并得到Llama-3-8B（清洗后的答案）的支持，但在其他四个模型上不成立。在Qwen2.5-7B的81个经一次重新提问后仍持续存在的错误中，重新提问、开启新对话或弃答修复几乎无法……（摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 该研究发现对话式问答中答案的改变主要由用户提供的答案载荷（具体答案字符串）驱动而非言语行为本身，且四种置信度信号相互分离——模型内部探测器追踪的是答案的持久性而非真实性。
en_tdlr: This study reveals that in conversational QA, answer changes are driven mainly by user-supplied answer payloads rather than speech acts alone, and the four confidence signals dissociate—the frozen internal probe tracks answer persistence rather than truthfulness.
